'''December 2000 Joliet tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Leisure Hours Hobbies, Joliet, Illinois on 16 December 2000. [[Al Schaefer]] won it. It is known from Al Schaefer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1553">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-17-joliet-il-12-16-00-year-end-mega-tournyd1553/ joliet-il-12-16-00-year-end-mega-tourny], DeckTech (Butt "ltkettch" Munch, 17 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-17-joliet-il-12-16-00-year-end-mega-tournyd1553/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Leisure Hours Hobbies, Joliet, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Al Schaefer]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Al Schaefer's report gives his last-round win over Eric Olson as 'FW by 22'; Steve Kuperman's report of the same event says Al won it by 23.<ref name="tr-d1553" />
* Steve Kuperman says Al Schaefer beat Eric Olson by 23 in the last round; Schaefer's own report gives 'FW by 22'.<ref name="tr-d1555" />
